operators.name: reflection_pad2d_forward

parameters.name: input
parameters.shape: [N, C, H, W] where padding will produce output shape [N, C, H+pad_top+pad_bottom, W+pad_left+pad_right]

returns.shape: same as reference nn.ReflectionPad2d((pad_left, pad_right, pad_top, pad_bottom))(input)

semantics: Implements reflection padding exactly as PyTorch nn.ReflectionPad2d with given left/right/top/bottom padding.
Padding values are reflected across the input edges without repeating the edge pixel (reflection, not replication).
Input and output tensors are torch.float32 CUDA tensors. Output is allocated with the same dtype and device as input.
The output shape is [N, C, H+pad_top+pad_bottom, W+pad_left+pad_right].
Supports non-contiguous input via proper indexing; output is contiguous.

operators.name: scaled_dot_product_attention_forward

parameters.name: q
parameters.shape: [N, H, L, D] or any shape supported by PyTorch F.scaled_dot_product_attention for non-batch matrix multiply

parameters.name: k
parameters.shape: same as q except last two dimensions may be [S, D]

parameters.name: v
parameters.shape: same as k except last dimension may be V

semantics: Implements PyTorch F.scaled_dot_product_attention(q, k, v, is_causal=is_causal) with exact default behavior including scale factor 1/sqrt(D).
Computes attention_logits = q @ k^T * scale; if is_causal is True, applies causal mask with -inf for positions j > i; then softmax over last dimension; finally output = softmax_logits @ v.

The function assumes q, k, v are at least 3-dimensional with matching batch dimensions. Last dimension of q and k (D) must match, and k and v second-to-last dimension (S) must match; output has shape of q.
Apply nn.ReflectionPad2d with padding (1,1,1,1) to input q of shape [32,8,1024,32], producing [32,8,1026,34] on cuda:0.
Reflection padding does not repeat edge pixels; indices are reflected across borders.
Apply nn.ReflectionPad2d with padding (1,1,1,1) to input k of shape [32,8,1024,32], producing [32,8,1026,34] on cuda:0.
Apply nn.ReflectionPad2d with padding (1,1,1,1) to input v of shape [32,8,1024,32], producing [32,8,1026,34] on cuda:0.
Compute scaled dot-product attention with is_causal=False. No causal mask is applied.
With is_causal=False, attention is full q-k matrix multiplication scaled by 1/sqrt(D), softmax over last dimension, then multiplication by v.
Return the attention output tensor of shape [32,8,1026,34].
